text: ナナミ　から　レッドへ　のんびりと　おちゃを　のんで　いるまに　とっても　つよく　なったのね　これからも　おとうとの　よき　ライバルで　いてね

structure.jp: ナナミ　から　レッドへ
のんびりと　おちゃを　のんで　いるまに
structure.en: while I was leisurely drinking tea

structure.jp: とっても　つよく　なったのね
structure.en: you became so very strong, didn't you

structure.jp: これからも　おとうとの　よき　ライバルで　いてね
structure.en: please keep being a good rival to my little brother

patterns.name: 〜間に
patterns.explanation: まに after a verb means 'during the time that', and something else happens within that time. のんで いるまに = 'while I was drinking'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives a soft 'so it is that...' tone, showing she has just realised it. This bare の is a gentle, feminine form of のだ. つよく なったのね = 'so you've become strong, haven't you'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb left at the end is a friendly way to ask someone to do something. ライバルで いてね = 'stay his rival, okay?'.
